mapper.select: SELECT b_id bId, out_id outId, out_type outType, destination, start_time startTime, end_time endTime, handling_matter handlingMatter, matter_detail matterDetail, `state`, user_id userId, trip_id tripId, operate, community_id communityId FROM business_outgoing WHERE b_id = #{bId} AND operate = #{operate}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO business_outgoing(b_id, out_id, out_type, destination, start_time, end_time, handling_matter, matter_detail, `state`, user_id, trip_id, operate, community_id) VALUES (#{bId}, #{outId}, #{outType}, #{destination}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{handlingMatter}, #{matterDetail}, #{state}, #{userId}, #{tripId}, #{operate}, #{communityId})

INSERT INTO outgoing(out_id, out_type, destination, start_time, end_time, handling_matter, matter_detail, `state`, user_id, trip_id, status_cd, b_id, community_id) SELECT out_id, out_type, destination, start_time, end_time, handling_matter, matter_detail, `state`, user_id, trip_id, '0', b_id, community_id FROM business_outgoing WHERE b_id = #{bId} AND operate = #{operate}
